card.name: Start of finasteride and similar names
card.fires_on: Responds to the opening piece of a longer name, such as Fin before asteride, fos in sofosbuvir, or anie in Stefanie. Also fires on broken characters in a garbled multilingual word list.

modes.label: Drug name openings
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name that continues in the next piece.

modes.label: Other names
modes.description: Opening pieces of person or language names, such as Stefanie or Finno-Ugric.

modes.label: Garbled characters
modes.description: Broken byte characters in a list of translations of the word bee.
